resources.string: Addresses you send to often. Every recipient field can pick from them. Search matches names, addresses, tags and notes.
No contacts yet. Tap + to save one.
Ways to keep a copy of your wallets. Everything is encrypted with a password you choose before it\'s saved.
Encrypt any secret phrase to a keystore, or decrypt a keystore back to its phrase.
Export wallets, contacts, settings and activity as one encrypted file.
Restoring from a backup file isn\'t available yet.
Convert any secret phrase to a keystore.
Decrypt any keystore to its secret phrase.
Copy or save this backup keystore somewhere secure.
Exports all wallets, contacts, settings and activity into an encrypted .json backup, encrypted with AES-GCM 256-bit and PBKDF2 (%1$d iterations).
Keep your password safe. It cannot be recovered.
Store your encrypted wallet backup in the cloud, with your data always encrypted on the device before it leaves.
The wallet you\'re using. Logging out deselects it. Its keystore stays on this device, so you can select it again from the Wallets tab.
The node the wallet reads balances from and sends transactions through. A change takes effect on the next request.
Endpoints you\'ve added. Tap the check to make one active, or the trash icon to remove it.
Add your own JSON-RPC endpoint, such as your own node or a provider like Alchemy. The URL must start with http:// or https://.
Follow the device\'s light or dark setting, or always use one.
Disables all network fetching: balances, gas prices, ENS lookups. Use this to sign transactions without broadcasting them.
All balance and network queries are paused. You can still sign transactions in the Sign tab; turn offline mode off to broadcast.
Route RPC traffic through a built-in VPN relay to improve privacy and prevent IP-based tracking by node providers.
